relationships.evidence_quote: In our study, magnetic stimulation intervention significantly reduced NLRP3 expression, decreased the levels of the pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-6 and TNF-α

key_findings: rTMS relieved pain and depressive-like behavior in CCI rats and lowered METTL3, m6A, YTHDF1, NMDAR2B, NLRP3, IL-6 and TNF-α while shifting microglia toward M2.
In BV2 cells, METTL3 inhibition or overexpression changed NMDAR2B and NLRP3 accordingly; NMDAR2B manipulation did not alter METTL3, placing NMDAR2B downstream.
